MERGE INTO MRO_PO_IPGO A USING ( SELECT $BUYER$ AS BUYER, $INV_NO$ AS INV_NO, $INV_SEQ$ AS INV_SEQ FROM DUAL ) B ON ( 1=1 AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.INV_NO = A.INV_NO AND B.INV_SEQ = A.INV_SEQ ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET PO_REQ_NO = $PO_REQ_NO$, GD_CD_MRO = $GD_CD_MRO$, IP_DT = $IP_DT$, STATUS = $STATUS$, GD_CD = $GD_CD$, DANGA = $DANGA$, IP_QTY = $IP_QTY$, LAST_UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( PO_REQ_NO, GD_CD_MRO, IP_DT, STATUS, GD_CD, DANGA, IP_QTY, BUYER, INV_NO, INV_SEQ, LAST_UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES ( $PO_REQ_NO$, $GD_CD_MRO$, $IP_DT$, $STATUS$, $GD_CD$, $DANGA$, $IP_QTY$, $BUYER$, $INV_NO$, $INV_SEQ$, SYSDATE )
